environment.host_condition: shared container; no CPU isolation or cache control

protocol.delay: Event-time median among detected patterns only; misses excluded.
protocol.latency: Every 100th process call; empirical p50/p95 including timer overhead and deterministic sampling bias.
protocol.memory: Linux VmHWM KiB per process including warmup/runtime/allocator/samples; null when unavailable.
protocol.scope: Synthetic-scenario evaluation, not real-world intrusion-detection accuracy.
protocol.thresholds: Bundled profiles, not single-variable causal experiment.
protocol.throughput: Generator + engine, 3 fresh processes per size, 5000 warmup excluded; no parsing/disk/API/capture.
protocol.unit: scenario × seed × source × detector; any alert predicts positive; repeats collapse. Seven scenarios, five seeds. No held-out corpus.
protocol.windows: Window duration varies; retention remains two windows. State peaks are counts, not bytes.
